title: Novalis
description: This project adds a mod called Novalis. It allows users to easily drag items inside different containers.
body:
Novalis is a lightweight, client-side mod designed to make your UI experience smoother.

This mod introduces an intuitive shift-and-click mechanic directly into your game menus. Instead of clicking repeatedly, you can seamlessly drag over items and put them into multiple, different UI's. Since it is entirely client-side, you can use Novalis on any vanilla server or multiplayer world without any issues. Enjoy my mod!
